## Day totals
- Scenes scheduled: 11 — completed: 4 — partial: 7 — pushed: 0
- Pages scheduled: 9 3/8 — shot: 9 3/8 (100%)
- Setups: 31 · Takes: 175 (38 circled, 42 NG) · Print ratio: 4.61:1 · Shooting ratio: 4.44:1
- Cumulative: pages shot 48 4/8 of 115 3/8 — behind by 3 4/8 pages

## Notes
- **Overtime:** Crew wrapped at 17:15, resulting in 15 minutes of overtime due to extra coverage on the last setup.
- **Continuity Issues:**
  - **Scene 12:** Set dressing mismatch (Severity 5) — In take B-01-B, the foreground character is sleeping under a newspaper on a balcony, whereas in take B-02-B, the set is dressed with a cot where the character is resting. Props mismatch (Severity 3) — In take B-01-B, the sniper loads a red cartridge into his rifle, which is absent in take B-02-B where the soldier only aims the weapon.
  - **Scene 27:** Action match mismatch (Severity 5) — In Take A, the older man is injured, clutching his shoulder and letting go of a rope, whereas in Take B he enters through a doorway showing no signs of injury and is accompanied by a young woman who is absent in Take A.
  - **Scene 33:** Dialogue mismatch (Severity 5) — In Take A, the cybernetic man asks the older man if he is ready and checks in with Barley, whereas in Take B, he repeatedly says 'Dom' and points out a target. Props mismatch (Severity 5) — In Take A, the cybernetic man handles a microphone and a radio antenna, which are completely absent in Take B. Action match mismatch (Severity 5) — In Take A, the cybernetic man stands in a three-shot handing off items, whereas in Take B, he physically pulls the older man close by the shoulder.
  - **Scene 39:** Props mismatch (Severity 3) — Hero glass is half full in TOS-D12-S39-A-01-B, nearly empty in TOS-D12-S39-D-01-A.
  - **Scene 6:** Wardrobe mismatch (Severity 1) — Jacket zipped in TOS-D12-S6-F-06-A but open in TOS-D12-S6-A-02-B at the same beat.
  - **Scene 91:** Lighting mismatch (Severity 1) — Practical is on in TOS-D12-S91-A-01-B and off in TOS-D12-S91-C-02-B; grade cannot match.
- **Technical Flags:**
  - Soft focus flagged on 11 takes (avg severity 3.09).
  - Boom in shot flagged on 7 takes (avg severity 3.57).
  - Audio clipping flagged on 5 takes (avg severity 3.00).
  - Line flubs on 9 takes, frame edge issues on 5 takes, and dialogue overlap on 2 takes.

sql: SELECT title, planned_days FROM slateiq.production LIMIT 1
SELECT shoot_date, unit, call_time, actual_wrap, planned_scenes, location, weather, notes FROM slateiq.shooting_day WHERE day_number = 12 LIMIT 1
SELECT day_number, pages_planned_eighths, pages_shot_eighths, setups, takes, circled, ng, camera_minutes, wrap_delay_min FROM slateiq.daily_progress WHERE day_number = 12 LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  (SELECT sum(pages_shot_eighths) FROM slateiq.daily_progress WHERE day_number <= 12) as cum_shot_eighths,
  (SELECT sum(pages_planned_eighths) FROM slateiq.daily_progress WHERE day_number <= 12) as cum_planned_eighths,
  (SELECT sum(page_eighths) FROM slateiq.scene) as total_script_eighths

SELECT 
  sum(duration_s) as total_duration,
  sumIf(duration_s, status='circled') as circled_duration,
  sum(duration_s) / greatest(sumIf(duration_s, status='circled'), 1) as shooting_ratio
FROM slateiq.take 
WHERE day_number = 12
DESCRIBE slateiq.scene_progress
SELECT * FROM slateiq.scene_progress LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM slateiq.take LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM slateiq.scene LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  t.scene_number,
  s.slug,
  s.page_eighths,
  sp.status as scene_status,
  count(distinct t.shot) as setups_today,
  count(t.take_id) as takes_today,
  countIf(t.status = 'circled') as circled_today
FROM slateiq.take t
JOIN slateiq.scene s ON t.scene_number = s.scene_number
JOIN slateiq.scene_progress sp ON t.scene_number = sp.scene_number
WHERE t.day_number = 12
GROUP BY t.scene_number, s.slug, s.page_eighths, sp.status
ORDER BY t.scene_number
LIMIT 100

SELECT scene_number, groupArray(distinct day_number) as days_shot
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE scene_number IN ('6', '12', '14A', '27', '33', '39', '41', '56', '78', '91', '102')
GROUP BY scene_number
ORDER BY scene_number
LIMIT 100

SELECT day_number, planned_scenes FROM slateiq.shooting_day WHERE has(planned_scenes, '12') OR has(planned_scenes, '14A') OR has(planned_scenes, '27') OR has(planned_scenes, '33') OR has(planned_scenes, '41') OR has(planned_scenes, '56') OR has(planned_scenes, '102') LIMIT 100
SELECT status, count() FROM slateiq.take WHERE day_number = 12 GROUP BY status
SELECT flag_type, flags, takes_affected, avg_severity FROM slateiq.flag_summary WHERE day_number = 12 ORDER BY flags DESC

SELECT scene_number, category, severity, description FROM slateiq.continuity_note WHERE scene_number IN ('6', '12', '14A', '27', '33', '39', '41', '56', '78', '91', '102') ORDER BY severity DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  scene_number,
  shot,
  take_number,
  groupArray(camera) as cameras,
  any(tc_in) as tc_in,
  any(duration_s) as duration,
  any(status) as status,
  any(director_note) as note
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12 AND status IN ('circled', 'hold')
GROUP BY scene_number, shot, take_number
ORDER BY scene_number, shot, take_number
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  scene_number,
  shot,
  take_number,
  groupArray(camera) as cameras,
  any(tc_in) as tc_in,
  any(duration_s) as duration,
  any(status) as take_status,
  any(director_note) as note
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12 AND status IN ('circled', 'hold')
GROUP BY scene_number, shot, take_number
ORDER BY scene_number, shot, take_number
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  scene_number,
  countIf(status NOT IN ('circled', 'hold')) as other_takes
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12
GROUP BY scene_number
ORDER BY scene_number
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  t.take_id,
  t.scene_number,
  t.shot,
  t.take_number,
  a.quality_score,
  a.performance_note,
  a.summary
FROM slateiq.take t
LEFT JOIN slateiq.take_analysis a USING take_id
WHERE t.day_number = 12 AND t.status = 'circled'
LIMIT 100
SELECT status, count() FROM slateiq.take WHERE day_number = 12 AND scene_number = '6' GROUP BY status

SELECT 
  scene_number,
  countIf(status = 'circled') as circled,
  countIf(status = 'hold') as hold,
  countIf(status NOT IN ('circled', 'hold')) as other
FROM slateiq.take
WHERE day_number = 12
GROUP BY scene_number
ORDER BY scene_number
LIMIT 100
